WIP(spike): keepalive-r2 A -- host standby entries (control-only, one active), contract draft (moved onto fix/capture-lifecycle 569059f)

The paused spike 328d616 (spike/host-admission, on 82b3d14) carried over unchanged onto fix/capture-lifecycle
569059f (LK-UX + capture-lifecycle), so R2 (PC 0.2.164) grows from the R1 candidate. The original branch is kept.

Standby* packets 311-316 (an old host ignores them = the support probe), StandbyTable (entry id + CSPRNG secret,
one per device, 8 per host, 20 s lease, replay/superseded rules), handled in the handshake loop and the UDP
reader; only StandbyActivate takes the session, through AdmitHello. Table test 25/25 (on 82b3d14). The real-host
e2e (host_standby_admission_e2e_test) is built but NOT yet run.

제품/테스트/문서: 제품(standby wire·table·host handshake, WIP) / 테스트(table·e2e, WIP) / 문서(계약 초안)
